shell.details: System activity rendered the four metrics, filters, authorized count, live state, and operator retention control at desktop and phone widths.

lifecycle.details: One durable import job moved queued -> running -> 42% -> succeeded at the same operation ID at both widths.

resultAuthorization.details: Succeeded import exposed Open authorized result at /pages/table.html?folder=workspace&table=result_file; direct navigation under the operator session loaded the table route. The phone detail was repeated after fixing the detail-query metadata projection.

retry.details: Retryable failure committed one idempotency-keyed fixture effect and then exhausted into dead-letter. Review and retry reused the same operation ID, attempted the same committed effect, and succeeded with exactly one committed effect row.

acknowledgement.details: A separate dead-letter became Acknowledged dead letter, remained present, cleared unread state, and persisted across reload.

cancellation.details: A running 25% job accepted cancellation and recorded Cancellation requested followed by Operation cancelled; the action disappeared at both widths.

reconnectReplay.details: A fixture-only 10-second SSE interruption showed Reconnecting. Work completed while disconnected, then replay resumed from cursor 5 and caught up to high-water cursor 8 without manual refresh or recovery UI.

crossUserIsolation.details: The operator saw no member job or running count; direct operator GET and cancel POST against the member job both returned 404. The member saw only its own job.

retention.details: Operator changed retention from 90 to 180 days; the worker completed the retention job and 180 persisted after reload. Member UI omitted the control and a forged member retention POST returned 403.

responsive.details: At 390x844 the table header was hidden, body rows computed to grid, detail width equaled 390px, and document horizontal overflow was zero. Desktop horizontal overflow was also zero.

expectedInstrumentation: Controlled 503 responses for the deliberately interrupted operations SSE stream
